name: Exception subgroup
meaning: The matching subset selected by except*; unmatched failures still propagate.

name: Structured task lifetime
meaning: A task group keeps child completion and failure inside the lifetime of its async context.

name: Dependency test double
meaning: A supplied stand-in whose behavior and recorded calls can be controlled in a test.

name: Logging threshold
meaning: The minimum severity accepted at a logging boundary; it does not itself redact sensitive message content.

name: Nested type contract
meaning: An annotation describing the types inside a container as well as its outer shape, without automatic runtime validation.

name: Timing repetition
meaning: Repeated bounded measurements of elapsed time, distinct from operation-count analysis or a speed guarantee.

name: Profile call count
meaning: A recorded number of function invocations in a particular executed workload, not a universal complexity or speed claim.
